works.title: Future AI Companions (untitled)
works.description: A literary work set 30 years in the future depicting AI assistant and companion personas as functioning well and integrated into human life. The user positions themselves as a 'future rider—just a half step ahead of the curve' by exploring diverse AI personality types inspired by Iain M. Banks' Culture series and contemporary relationship theory.
works.quote: I'm going to write in a literary universe set 30 years in the future, depicting AI assistants as if they already work well, to position myself as a kind of future rider—just a half step ahead of the curve.

works.title: Narrative Elements Framework
works.description: A structured framework for translating conceptual narrative elements (worldbuilding, character psychology, thematic material) into specific, actionable implementation details that can be directly placed into character profiles, settings, chapters, and scenes. Designed to complement a separate ideation framework by providing direct implementation guidance.
works.quote: I've been working on a narrative elements framework and just applied it to a story I'm developing. I'm not satisfied with the output and want to review how I can improve the framework to produce better results.
